WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS average_quantity,
        AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS relative_gap
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS overall_average_quantity
    FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT
    ia.invoice_number,
    ia.average_quantity,
    ia.relative_gap,
    ia.average_quantity - oa.overall_average_quantity AS above_overall_average
FROM invoice_averages AS ia
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE ia.average_quantity > oa.overall_average_quantity
ORDER BY above_overall_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: `product_quantity` is stored as text but contains numeric values; cast it to decimal for averages, with nonnumeric values treated according to the SQL engine's cast behavior. Zero total cost yields a NULL relative gap.
